		private void OnUOMChanged()
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SPEC_TYPE.@id", "value"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			string empty2 = string.Empty;
			int num = 0;
			switch (text)
			{
			case "MASS-FLOW":
			case "MASS-D":
			case "MASS-B":
			case "MASS-L1":
			case "MASS-VN":
				num = 10;
				break;
			case "MOLE-FLOW":
			case "MOLE-D":
			case "MOLE-B":
			case "MOLE-L1":
			case "MOLE-VN":
				num = 11;
				break;
			case "STDVOL-L1":
			case "STDVOL-VN":
			case "STDVOL-B":
			case "STDVOL-D":
			case "STDVOL-FLOW":
				num = 12;
				break;
			case "Q1":
			case "QN":
				num = 13;
				break;
			case "TEMP":
				num = 22;
				break;
			case "PROP-DIFF":
			case "PROP":
			{
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.PROPERTY.@id", "value"));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					string text3 = MmgExtensions.MMGGetPropSetUnit((MMViewModel)(object)this, text2);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)text3);
					_currentUOM = text3;
				}
				else
				{
					ResetUOM();
				}
				return;
			}
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			num--;
			empty2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.Unit Set", "value"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty2))
			{
				empty2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("Top.appModelV8.Setup.Unit Set.Global.Input.INSET", "value"));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty2))
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			empty = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("Top.appModelV8.Setup.Units-Sets." + empty2 + ".Unit-Types.#" + num, "value"));
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)empty);
			_currentUOM = empty;
		}

		private void ResetUOM()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_currentUOM))
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)"");
				_currentUOM = "";
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			OnUOMChanged();
		}

		private static double SigFigs(double value, int places)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (value == 0.0 || value == 1E+35)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			num = (int)(Math.Log(Math.Abs(value)) / Math.Log(10.0));
			return Round(value * Math.Pow(10.0, -num), -(places - 1)) * Math.Pow(10.0, num);
		}

		private static double Round(double value, int places)
		{
			return Convert.ToDouble(Convert.ToInt64(value * Math.Pow(10.0, -places))) / Math.Pow(10.0, -places);
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			UpdateGrid();
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd == advcboPhase3_var1_Property && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				UpdateGrid();
			}
			else if (pd == advcboPhase2_var1_Property && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				UpdateGrid();
			}
			else if (pd == advcboBasis_var1_Property && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				UpdateGrid();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private void UpdateGrid()
		{
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.NQL1COMP", "child_count"));
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				if (num.Value > 0)
				{
					Compadv2();
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("cboPhase2Visible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("cboPhase3Visible", (object)"1");
				}
				else
				{
					Compadv1();
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("cboPhase2Visible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("cboPhase3Visible", (object)"0");
				}
			}
		}

		private void Compadv1()
		{
			string basis = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("compbs"));
			string phase = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("_2phase"));
			UpdateAdv1Parameter(basis, phase);
		}

		private void Compadv2()
		{
			string basis = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("compbs"));
			string phase = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("_3phase"));
			UpdateAdv2Parameter(basis, phase);
		}

		private void UpdateAdv1Parameter(string basis, string phase)
		{
			if (phase == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Vapor_1)
			{
				if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mole)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQVAPCOMP");
				}
				else if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mass)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQVAPMCMP");
				}
				else if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_StdVol)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQVAPVCMP");
				}
			}
			else if (phase == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Liquid_1)
			{
				if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mole)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQLIQCOMP");
				}
				else if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mass)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQLIQMCMP");
				}
				else if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_StdVol)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQLIQVCMP");
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAdv2Parameter(string basis, string phase)
		{
			UpdateAdv1Parameter(basis, phase);
			if (phase == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_1st_liquid)
			{
				if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mole)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQL1COMP");
				}
				else if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mass)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQL1MCMP");
				}
				else if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_StdVol)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQL1VCMP");
				}
			}
			else if (phase == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_2nd_liquid)
			{
				if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mole)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQL2COMP");
				}
				else if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_Mass)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQL2MCMP");
				}
				else if (basis == Resources.MMRadfrac_NQResu_Compsi_ViewModel__CxvAdvCollectionItem_Display_StdVol)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("propcomp", (object)"NQL2VCMP");
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetDBVal(string propertyName, double dbvalue)
		{
			string text = null;
			text = ((!(dbvalue > -9E+34) || !(dbvalue < 9E+34)) ? string.Empty : dbvalue.ToString(Getdspstr(dbvalue), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter(propertyName, (object)text);
		}

		private string Getdspstr(double cvtval)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 1E-06)
			{
				return "0.#####E-##";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 1.0)
			{
				return "0.#######";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 10.0)
			{
				return "##.######";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 100.0)
			{
				return "###.#####";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 1000.0)
			{
				return "######.####";
			}
			if (Math.Abs(cvtval) < 10000.0)
			{
				return "#######.###";
			}
			return "0.#####E+##";
		}

		private string[] variableName()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("RECORDTYPE"));
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("TYPE"));
			if (text != "PETROFRACS")
			{
				if (text2 == "PACKSIZING")
				{
					list.Add("PS_PACKTYPE");
					list.Add("PS_VENDOR");
					list.Add("PS_PACK_MAT");
					list.Add("PS_PACK_SIZE");
					list.Add("PS_PACK_FAC");
					list.Add("PS_SPAREA");
					list.Add("PS_VOIDFR");
					list.Add("PS_STICH1");
					list.Add("PS_STICH2");
					list.Add("PS_STICH3");
				}
				else if (text2 == "PACKRATING")
				{
					list.Add("PR_PACKTYPE");
					list.Add("PR_VENDOR");
					list.Add("PR_PACK_MAT");
					list.Add("PR_PACK_SIZE");
					list.Add("PR_PACK_FAC");
					list.Add("PR_SPAREA");
					list.Add("PR_VOIDFR");
					list.Add("PR_STICH1");
					list.Add("PR_STICH2");
					list.Add("PR_STICH3");
					if (text == "RADFRAC")
					{
						list.Add("PR_BS_CL");
						list.Add("PR_BS_CV");
					}
				}
			}
			else if (text2 == "PACKSIZING")
			{
				list.Add("SPSPACKTYPE");
				list.Add("SPSVENDOR");
				list.Add("SPSPACK_MAT");
				list.Add("SPSPACK_SIZE");
				list.Add("SPSPACK_FAC");
				list.Add("SPSSPAREA");
				list.Add("SPSVOIDFR");
				list.Add("SPSSTICH1");
				list.Add("SPSSTICH2");
				list.Add("SPSSTICH3");
			}
			else if (text2 == "PACKRATING")
			{
				list.Add("SPRPACKTYPE");
				list.Add("SPRVENDOR");
				list.Add("SPRPACK_MAT");
				list.Add("SPRPACK_SIZE");
				list.Add("SPRPACK_FAC");
				list.Add("SPRSPAREA");
				list.Add("SPRVOIDFR");
				list.Add("SPRSTICH1");
				list.Add("SPRSTICH2");
				list.Add("SPRSTICH3");
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void MMCmdSelected_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= 2; i++)
			{
				object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB" + i);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Check" + i, (object)false);
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Check" + i, (object)(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(obj.ToString())));
				}
			}
			string value = ((((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB3") == null) ? "" : ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB3").ToString());
			string value2 = ((((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB4") == null) ? "" : ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB4").ToString());
			string value3 = ((((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB5") == null) ? "" : ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB5").ToString());
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Check3", (object)(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value3)));
			for (int j = 4; j <= 5; j++)
			{
				object obj2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB" + (j + 2));
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Check" + j, (object)(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(obj2.ToString())));
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Check" + j, (object)false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void MMCmdOK_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if ((bool)((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("CheckSave"))
			{
				SetSaveDB("YES");
			}
			else
			{
				SetSaveDB("NO");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i <= 2; i++)
			{
				if ((bool)((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("Check" + i))
				{
					string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "Current" + i + "_Data.DataPath"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text, "value", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB" + i));
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 3; j <= 5; j++)
			{
				if ((bool)((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("Check3"))
				{
					string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "Current" + j + "_Data.DataPath"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text2, "value", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB" + j));
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 6; k <= 7; k++)
			{
				if ((bool)((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("Check" + (k - 2)))
				{
					string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "Current" + k + "_Data.DataPath"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(text3, "value", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("DB" + k));
					}
				}
			}
			SetSaveDB("DEFAULT");
			((MMViewModel)this).CloseForm();
		}

		private void MMCmdCancel_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			SetSaveDB("DEFAULT");
			((MMViewModel)this).CloseForm();
		}

		private void SetSaveDB(string savedb)
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("TYPE").ToString();
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("@main.Input.");
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("RECORDTYPE").ToString() == "PETROFRACS")
			{
				if (text == "PACKSIZING")
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("SPS_SAVEDB");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("SPR_SAVEDB");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(".").Append(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id").ToString()).Append(".")
					.Append(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id2"));
			}
			else
			{
				if (text == "PACKSIZING")
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("PS_SAVEDB");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("PR_SAVEDB");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(".").Append(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id").ToString());
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(stringBuilder.ToString(), "value", (object)savedb);
		}

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length == 4)
			{
				object obj = values[0];
				_ = values[1];
				object obj2 = values[2];
				object obj3 = values[3];
				bool? flag = obj2 as bool?;
				string value = null;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					value = obj.ToString();
				}
				string text = null;
				if (obj3 != null)
				{
					text = obj3.ToString();
				}
				if ((!flag.HasValue || !flag.Value) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && text != "0")
				{
					return Visibility.Visible;

		{

		private void SetVisibility()
		{
			watch.PropertyDependencyChanged -= watch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
			watch.Clear();
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("reb"));
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.TH_FLAG", "value", (string)null, watch));
			if (text == "Thermosiphon reboiler summary")
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraReboilerVisible", (object)"1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraCompProfVisible", (object)"0");
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					if (num.Value == -1)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraColdtoHotVisible", (object)"1");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraHottoColdVisible", (object)"0");
					}
					else if (num.Value == 1)
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraColdtoHotVisible", (object)"0");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraHottoColdVisible", (object)"1");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraColdtoHotVisible", (object)"0");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraHottoColdVisible", (object)"0");
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraColdtoHotVisible", (object)"0");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraHottoColdVisible", (object)"0");
				}
			}
			else if (text == "Composition profiles")
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraReboilerVisible", (object)"0");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraCompProfVisible", (object)"1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraColdtoHotVisible", (object)"0");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("fraHottoColdVisible", (object)"0");
			}
			if (!watch.IsEmpty)
			{
				watch.PropertyDependencyChanged += watch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
			}
		}

		private void SetGridData()
		{
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.TH_X", "value"));
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				if (num.Value > 0)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("one", (object)"TH_X");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("two", (object)"TH_Y");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("GridVisible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Grid1Visible", (object)"0");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("one", (object)"TH_X1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("two", (object)"TH_X2");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("three", (object)"TH_Y");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Grid1Visible", (object)"1");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("GridVisible", (object)"0");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("one", (object)"TH_X");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("two", (object)"TH_Y");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("GridVisible", (object)"1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("Grid1Visible", (object)"0");
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			if (!((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] obj = new string[10] { "@main.Input.BASIS_D", "@main.Input.BASIS_RR", "@main.Input.BASIS_B", "@main.Input.BASIS_L1", "@main.Input.BASIS_VN", "@main.Input.BASIS_BR", "@main.Input.D:F", "@main.Input.B:F", "@main.Input.Q1", "@main.Input.QN" };
			_valueWatch = ((CxvViewModel)this).CreateCxsWatch();
			string[] array = obj;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				string text2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(text);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					_valueWatch.AddWatch(text2, "value");
				}
			}
			_ = _valueWatch.Values;
			_valueWatch.ValuesChanged += _valueWatch_ValuesChanged;
		}

		private void _valueWatch_ValuesChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			object spc = Spc1;
			CxvSpecPropertyData val = (CxvSpecPropertyData)((spc is CxvSpecPropertyData) ? spc : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			val.RefreshOptions();
			val.UpdateSelectedItem();
			if (val.Specs == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CxvSpecPropertyDataItem spec in val.Specs)
			{
				spec.RaiseIsEnteredChanged();
			}
		}

		public override void Unload()
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).Unload();
			if (_valueWatch != null)
			{
				_valueWatch.ValuesChanged -= _valueWatch_ValuesChanged;
				_valueWatch.Unload();
				_valueWatch = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_Inactive", (object)Resources.MMRadfrac_SpecSummary_Spec_ViewModel_Inactive);
				string[] obj = new string[10] { "@main.Input.BASIS_D", "@main.Input.BASIS_RR", "@main.Input.BASIS_B", "@main.Input.BASIS_L1", "@main.Input.BASIS_VN", "@main.Input.BASIS_BR", "@main.Input.D:F", "@main.Input.B:F", "@main.Input.Q1", "@main.Input.QN" };
				_valueWatch = ((CxvViewModel)this).CreateCxsWatch();
				string[] array = obj;
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					string text2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(text);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
					{
						_valueWatch.AddWatch(text2, "value");
					}
				}
				_ = _valueWatch.Values;
				_valueWatch.ValuesChanged += _valueWatch_ValuesChanged;
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		private void _valueWatch_ValuesChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			object spc = Spc1;
			CxvSpecPropertyData val = (CxvSpecPropertyData)((spc is CxvSpecPropertyData) ? spc : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			val.RefreshOptions();
			val.UpdateSelectedItem();
			if (val.Specs == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CxvSpecPropertyDataItem spec in val.Specs)
			{
				spec.RaiseIsEnteredChanged();
			}
		}

		public override void Unload()
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).Unload();
			if (_valueWatch != null)
			{
				_valueWatch.ValuesChanged -= _valueWatch_ValuesChanged;
				_valueWatch.Unload();
				_valueWatch = null;
			}
		}

		private void rowDoubleClick_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			IEnumerator<string> enumerator = GetSelectedIds().GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				string text = ".!" + enumerator.Current;
				((MMViewModel)this).GoToNode(text, (string)null, false);
			}
		}

		private void cmdAdd_CommandExecute(object parameter)

		private void cmdEdit_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			int allSelectedRecordsCount = AllSelectedRecordsCount;
			if (allSelectedRecordsCount == 0 || allSelectedRecordsCount > 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			using IEnumerator<string> enumerator = GetSelectedIds().GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				string current = enumerator.Current;
				string text = ".!" + current;
				((MMViewModel)this).GoToNode(text, (string)null, false);
			}
		}

		private void cmdDelete_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Collection<string> collection = new Collection<string>();
			string text = parameter as string;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				collection.Add(text);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (string selectedId in GetSelectedIds())
				{
					collection.Add(selectedId);
				}
			}
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(text2, (IEnumerable<string>)collection, false);
		}

		private void cmdRename_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			int allSelectedRecordsCount = AllSelectedRecordsCount;
			if (allSelectedRecordsCount == 0 || allSelectedRecordsCount > 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			string text2 = "";
			foreach (string selectedId in GetSelectedIds())
			{
				text2 = selectedId;
				((MMViewModel)this).ShowRenameChildDialog(text, ref text2, false);
			}
		}

		private void cmdHide_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Collection<string> collection = new Collection<string>();
			foreach (string selectedId in GetSelectedIds())
			{
				collection.Add(selectedId);
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			((MMViewModel)this).HideNodeChildren(text, (IEnumerable<string>)collection, false);
		}

		private void cmdReveal_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			((MMViewModel)this).ShowRevealNodeDialog(text);
		}

		private void OnAllSelectedRecordsCountChanged()
		{
			if (this.AllSelectedRecordsCountChanged != null)
			{
				this.AllSelectedRecordsCountChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("AllSelectedRecordsCount");
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds()
		{
			IList gridData = grdChild_GridData as IList;
			foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
			{
				if (selectedRowIndex >= 0 && selectedRowIndex < gridData.Count)
				{
					grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate = gridData[selectedRowIndex] as grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate;
					yield return grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate.GetId();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
				if (text.EndsWith("Design Specs"))
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_active", (object)"SPEC_ACTIVE");
				}
				else if (text.EndsWith("Vary"))
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_active", (object)"VARY_ACTIVE");
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_Inactive", (object)Resources.MMRadfrac_SpecSummary_Spec_ViewModel_Inactive);
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		public void SetSelectedRowFromScript(int row)
		{
			if (SelectedRowIndexes == null)
			{
				SelectedRowIndexes = new ObservableCollection<int>();
			}
			SelectedRowIndexes.Clear();
			SelectedRowIndexes.Add(row);
			AllSelectedRecordsCount = 1;
		}
